subject: Request: admin activity evidence and export options for SOC 2 / SIG - Acme Health
messages:
From: Jared Mills <jmills@acmehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: compliance@acmehealth.com
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Admin activity evidence request for SOC 2 - scope and formats

Hi Neha,

We're starting evidence collection for our SOC 2 Type II audit and need a scoped export of Redwood's admin activity for Acme Health. Auditor questions: what admin events are logged, retention windows, and what formats you can provide for an evidence handoff (preferably S3-ready).

Specifically we need:
- All admin actions (user provisioning/deprovisioning, role changes, permission grants, API key creation/revocation, model routing/fallback events)
- Timestamps (UTC), actor user id, IP address, user agent, affected resource id, and request payload IDs where applicable
- A manifest with HMAC or checksum per file

Can you confirm retention of IPs and whether you can provide an 18-month window? Also curious about sampling/playback options for high-volume accounts and any PII redaction controls you apply.

Can you confirm timeline (auditor wants delivery by 2026-06-11) and required contact for SFTP/S3 handoff?

Thanks,
Jared Mills
Head of Compliance
Acme Health

---
Attachments: none
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Mills <jmills@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 10:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity evidence request for SOC 2 - scope and formats

Thanks Jared — looping in Karthik (infra/exports) and Laura (compliance ops). High level answers up front, details below.

Summary (short):
- Logged event set: user lifecycle events, auth failures, API key lifecycle, role/perm changes, model routing decisions, operator console actions, and administrative configuration changes.
- Retention: operational store retains admin activity for 720 days (2 years) with secure cold archive available for up to 7 years on request.
- IPs: Yes, source IP and user agent are captured and included in exports by default.
- Export formats & delivery: gzipped JSONL (preferred), CSV for smaller slices, and an S3 presigned + manifest with SHA256 checksums + HMAC metadata. Delivery options: customer S3 (preferred), secure SFTP, or signed Drive link for smaller bundles.
- Timeline: we can deliver a canonical 18-month export sample within 48hrs and full 18-month archive in 5-7 business days, pending agreed scope and legal handoff.

A few clarifying Qs:
1) Confirm the exact time window (start/end UTC). You mentioned 18 months — please list start date to avoid ambiguity.
2) Do you require IP addresses in cleartext or hashed/anonymized? For some regulated workflows we can hash last-octet or provide PII-redacted exports.
3) Any format constraints from your auditor (they prefer JSONL + manifest).

I'll attach our export playbook and a sample manifest. Karthik/Laura: if anything else for extraction/attestation, please add.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: export_playbook_s3_gzip.pdf, admin_activity_sample_manifest.jsonl
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jared Mills <jmills@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity evidence request for SOC 2 - scope and formats

Quick engineering note on extraction scope and integrity:
- Scope: We'll pull partitioned JSONL slices keyed by account_id + day. Each record includes: timestamp_utc, actor_principal_id, actor_email, event_type, resource_id, resource_type, request_id, src_ip, user_agent, request_payload_id, change_summary.
- Exclusions: ephemeral kernel-level traces and highly transient debug logs are excluded (we keep operator audit records only).
- Integrity: Exports are chunked at ~250k records per gzipped file, each file with SHA256 and an overall manifest signed with an HMAC-SHA256 key that we provide. If you prefer signed PGP, we can accommodate — let us know.
- Redaction: We can emit either raw IPs or hashed-ip (SHA256 of ip+salt) and can remove payloads on a per-field basis. Redaction policy will be recorded in the manifest.
- Delivery: preferred: your S3 bucket + role-based write access (we'll supply temporary STS creds). Alternatives: SFTP (FTPS) or secure upload to our customer-only Drive link (for small slices).

Operational timeline: 48hrs for a sampled 7-day export; 5 business days for 90-day window; 7 business days for 18 months (subject to queue). We'll prioritize if this is for active auditor deadlines.

Karthik
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: Jared Mills <jmills@acmehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: compliance@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity evidence request for SOC 2 - scope and formats

Thanks — that looks good. Confirming:
- Time window: 2024-12-01T00:00:00Z through 2026-05-31T23:59:59Z (approx 18 months)
- We need cleartext source IPs for the auditor (they will treat IPs as system metadata, not PII). If Redwood needs to mask anything, please call out explicitly.
- Manifest with checksums and HMAC is required.

Also: do you provide an attestation letter (signed) that lists which tables/keys were excluded from the export? Our SOC auditor requires a short scope letter.

If you can do the sample within 48 hours and start the full export asap, we can route the results to our S3 bucket (acme-health-logs-us-east-1). I'll share write role in a minute.

Jared

Note: compliance@acmehealth.com asked whether timestamps include sub-second precision and whether timezone is normalized — they prefer ISO 8601 UTC with millisecond precision.
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Mills <jmills@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity evidence request for SOC 2 - scope and formats

All set — final notes and next steps:

1) Scope confirmed for 2024-12-01T00:00:00Z -> 2026-05-31T23:59:59Z.
2) IPs: included in cleartext. We will also include a hashed-ip column for reference; manifest will indicate both.
3) Timestamp format: ISO 8601 UTC with millisecond precision (e.g., 2026-06-02T17:48:22.123Z).
4) Export format: gzipped JSONL chunks + admin_activity_sample_manifest.jsonl (attached) with SHA256 per file and an HMAC-SHA256 over the manifest.
5) Redaction: none requested — full payload fields emitted except for any customer-requested payloads; if Acme later requests PII redaction we will produce an alternate bundle.
6) Attestation: Laura will prepare a short scope letter listing exclusions (ephemeral debug traces, internal kernel traces, test accounts flagged by tag) — expect signed PDF within 2 business days.
7) Timeline: sample 7-day slice (UTC 2026-05-01 -> 2026-05-07) will be uploaded to acme-health-logs-us-east-1 via temporary write role within 24-48 hours. Full 18-month export estimated 6 business days from confirmed S3 role.

Action items:
- Jared: share STS role or SFTP endpoint and any ACL constraints.
- Laura: produce attestation letter and list of excluded record classes.
- Karthik: queue export job; mark high-priority for Acme audit.

Thanks — we’ll send the sample link once uploaded.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
